details: I feel like lately,vr chat has been banning alot of good avatars for no good reason especially by black content creators.It makes the system feel like it's being run by AI rather then a genuine human at this point,I'm not sure if there is a bug in the vrchat banning system or this coming out. Alot of avis such as chibi's,mankuas,fooshis, or great sfw avis, and most of the time avis made by black content creators. Its been hard to find an actual good contented avi that meets in the middle quality for both quest and pc users, but it feels like the momment it gets a slight scent of popularity it gets ban leaving us with the poor polygon avis. It feels like these bans are being Ai targeted and I dont think theres a real team behind any sort of bands now these days and vrc is to focus on building stuff no one asked for or building stuff to pull more money out of people.lowkey missing the old vrc now ngl. Back when we didnt have Ai and things were done by actual people. Something tells me after stating my opinion vrchat might just ban me for breathing here.
title: Vrchat random avi/people ban system
